about: What differs between the chips for the Inside a gate page. Everything else in docs/tools/views_*.py, docs/views/views.js, views.css and test/views/*.py,*.js is shared unchanged by tiqora-skywater130 and tinytapeout-tiqora.

tp_ncore.5->2: S_MEM to S_PASS: S_MEM is entered on phase 0 and leaves for S_PASS only on phase 7, so the memory must answer in a multiple of 8 clocks. Not seen in 3,000 random programs (test/memlat.py): every stay was 1, 18, 26, 30, 38, 45 or 50 clocks. Evidence, not a proof.
tp_ncore.6->2: S_XP to S_PASS: unreachable. S_XP is entered on phase 0 and always leaves after one clock, on phase 0, so to_wb is S_ALIGN.
